theme: A wide-open Sunday to clear the decks.
greeting: The calendar's empty and the girls are with Jen, Dan, so the whole day is yours in Maine. The only threads worth pulling are a couple of overdue errands and the start of Mike's surgery week.

needsAttention.detail: His oral surgery is Thursday in Portland. Your prep task flags confirming pre-op instructions with the surgeon's office around now, with the driver, meds, and soft food to line up before Wednesday.

recipe.title: Olive oil–poached zucchini & raw tomatoes
recipe.why: Peak-summer zucchini and just-picked tomatoes, softened slowly in good olive oil — exactly the unhurried supper a quiet Maine evening is asking for.

Surgery week starts tomorrow, so a quiet night to get Mike's pre-op logistics settled.
